prompt:
A wide 4:1 landscape picture, a side-view effect, the Needle spell's penetration impact, for a 2D game, painted as four animation stages of one effect that float side by side on open, empty green. Only the effect is painted; whatever it touches or comes from stays off the canvas. The four stages share one horizontal centre line, centred at one sixteenth, three sixteenths, five sixteenths and so on up to fifteen sixteenths of the picture width, with the same wide band of empty green around each, so every stage sits alone in the open and none comes near another or the picture edge. Everything is drawn in flat side view with no perspective, at the size of a game sprite; the longest stage spans about a fifth of the picture width.

A gold sliver arrives from the left and drives through an unseen target. Stage 1 (contact): the sliver's point at the centre of the stage, a hard pale-cream flash at the tip with four tiny sharp rays. Stage 2 (penetration): the sliver driven in, a tight eight-pointed star-shaped gold flare around the tip, the longest points on the horizontal axis. Stage 3 (through): thin gold shards and fine spark streaks thrown out forward to the right in a narrow fan, the sliver's tail still glowing on the left. Stage 4 (fade): a small scatter of tiny pointed diamond sparks and short broken gold dashes, thin and pale, the faintest stage. The palette is warm gold #E9C46A, amber #F5AA28, deep bronze #94611E and pale cream #FFF5DC with a near-black ink edge: one warm gold family, nothing else. Sparkles are sharp, faceted blades like cut spear tips.


Eight distinct frames, not four: each of the stages described above is shown as two consecutive steps, the second slightly further along than the first, so no two of the eight frames are alike and the motion reads smoothly from left to right. Draw big and bold: every shape is large, filling most of the height of the picture, with a thick, bold near-black ink outline (about a twelfth of the shape's width), strong contrast from near-black shadow to bright cream highlights, visible etched cross-hatching on the shaded sides, and a clear faceted, angular design with small ink-edged shards and sparks around it. Shapes read clearly even when shrunk to a tiny game sprite.

Style: a dark painterly etched storybook illustration, ink and wash with fine etched cross-hatching and a faint paper grain inside the shapes only. Large shapes have a clean near-black ink outline #171614 about 2 px wide at this size; hair-thin streaks and tiny sparks carry a hairline ink edge so they keep their colour. One light source sits in front and slightly above: upper edges brighter, lower edges shaded with fine hatching. The glow stays inside each shape, brightest at the core and fading toward the ink outline. The background is one perfectly flat, even, pure green #00FF00 from edge to edge, the shapes cut cleanly against it, and the shapes themselves use only the palette above. The canvas holds only the eight effects floating on the green, as a clean sprite strip with nothing else on it.
